title: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Expansion via Cross-Lingual Embedding Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.30123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual pretraining with vocabulary expansion is often used to make large language models (LLMs) more effective and efficient at handling new languages. However, when LLMs are extended to many languages simultaneously, the number of model parameters increases significantly. In addition, the newly added tokens do not receive the same number of training steps as the tokens in the original vocabulary, which sometimes causes vocabulary expansion to yield only limited performance improvements. We propose leveraging the semantic equivalence between words in the model's primary language and those in the extended vocabulary to transfer learned representations. In this paper, we introduce MATE, a parameter-efficient vocabulary expansion method that enables effective cross-lingual transfer with 8 times fewer additional parameters per token. MATE reduces the average tokenization compression ratio and delivers improvements on multiple benchmarks.

translated_title: 通过跨语言嵌入对齐实现参数高效的词表扩展
translated_abstract: 通过词表扩展进行持续预训练常被用于使大语言模型（LLM）在处理新语言时更有效、更高效。然而，当LLM同时扩展到多种语言时，模型参数数量会显著增加。此外，新增的词元无法获得与原始词表中的词元相同数量的训练步数，这有时导致词表扩展只能带来有限的性能提升。我们提出利用模型主要语言中的词汇与扩展词表中的词汇之间的语义等价性来迁移已学习的表示。在本文中，我们介绍了MATE，这是一种参数高效的词表扩展方法，能够在每个词元仅需八分之一的额外参数的情况下实现有效的跨语言迁移。MATE降低了平均分词压缩比，并在多个基准测试中带来了性能提升。
tldr: 提出参数高效的词表扩展方法MATE，通过利用主语言与扩展语言词汇间的语义等价性进行跨语言嵌入对齐，使每个词元的额外参数减少8倍，同时提升多个基准测试的性能。
en_tdlr: MATE, a parameter-efficient vocabulary expansion method, leverages cross-lingual embedding alignment via semantic equivalence to transfer learned representations, requiring 8 times fewer additional parameters per token while delivering improvements on multiple benchmarks.
